attempts.summary: On node1 (CentOS Stream 10), installed rootless podman, created unprivileged user appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges, enabled systemd lingering for appsvc, and deployed a Quadlet-defined rootless container (nginx:alpine) publishing port 8080 via a user systemd service (webapp.service) wanted by default.target. Verified the service starts at boot without any active login session for appsvc, survives a full node reboot, and serves HTTP 200 on port 8080 both before and after the restart.
